work_items.title: Deliver deterministic in-memory RNA velocity foundation
work_items.objective: Implement an installable C++20 module using the required anndata.cppm dependency, streaming moments and steady-state velocity with caller-controlled outputs and bounded scratch memory, and independent numerical and memory qualification.
work_items.outcome: A native consumer can compute the declared in-memory moments and steady-state velocity with explicit filtering and reference-bypass behavior, supported by reproducible numerical, installation, sanitizer, and memory evidence.

assertions: The required native workflow configures and builds the C++20 module and passes native and separately installed consumer checks with the required anndata.cppm dependency.
Moments and deterministic steady-state velocity are qualified against independent numerical references, including declared edge cases, filtering defaults, and custom reference bypass.

Streaming and caller-owned output paths are exercised; accumulation uses FP64 and a reproducible measurement establishes less than 64 MiB scratch for blocks of at most 64 genes under the stated measurement conditions.
Sanitizer qualification and oracle, memory, and native results record their workload, toolchain, and limitations without asserting unmeasured performance.
The milestone is restricted to the declared in-memory deterministic path; GPU, backed storage, and stochastic velocity are outside its scope.

requirements.description: Run the required native, installed-consumer, and qualification workflow in the qualified workspace.
